messages:
sarah (primary-oncall): FYI handing off from afternoon shift. We had a customer-impacting spike on embeddings in us-east starting ~15:20 PT, pages fired, oncall handled it and I'm summarizing for next shift.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: EMBEDDINGS_AUTOSCALER_THROTTLE (sev3) — multiple 429s and 504s across batch-embed workers in us-east and eu-west.

morgan (eng-sre): Root cause (prelim): autoscaler started aggressive scale-to-zero churn after a bad config change pushed earlier — nodes kept booting/evicting, causing queue backlog -> per-request timeouts. CPU was plateauing, and redis kv-cache miss rate went up.

sarah (primary-oncall): Customer impact: ~45 customers saw increased latency and intermittent 429 for embed calls; some background jobs retried and amplified load. No data loss.

diego (secondary): Actions taken so far: 1) pinned scaler config to previous stable commit (reverted deploy). 2) disabled scale-to-zero for the embeddings ASG to stop churn. 3) temporary per-customer rate-limiter applied to slow heavy clients. 4) increased batcher workers by +2 for us-east.

ops-notify-bot: Deployed config rollback to embeddings-autoscaler (rev: r2026-05-10-83) — rollout 3/3 hosts — health checks passing.

morgan (eng-sre): Observability notes: p95 token latency down from 3.8s -> 1.2s in us-east after fixes. Error rate still slightly elevated in eu-west (20% above baseline) due to rolling restart backlog.

sarah (primary-oncall): Mitigation status: mitigated for us-east, partial mitigation eu-west. No customer escalations opened beyond support tickets.

diego (secondary): Open tasks for next shift: - monitor eu-west queue depth and evictions for 2h - coordinate with infra to patch autoscaler threshold bug (PR #482) - schedule a follow-up runbook update (see link) - check cost impact of keeping scale-to-zero off (estimate ~+8% over next 24h).

sarah (primary-oncall): Runbook pointers: https://redwood.company/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler — follow "Emergency revert" section if autoscaler starts throttling again. Quick commands below.

morgan (eng-sre): Snippet to restart the autoscaler safely (run from maintenance window):
```bash
# drain single autoscaler host
kubectl cordon autoscaler-host-7 -n infra
kubectl drain autoscaler-host-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n infra
# restart autoscaler controller
kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-controller -n infra
# verify health
kubectl get pods -l app=autoscaler -n infra -o wide
```

sarah (primary-oncall): Temporary policy I added: rate_limit: 1200r/m per org for embeddings for the next 6 hours. Will relax as eu-west stabilizes.

diego (secondary): Notes on coverage: I'm primary for the east shift tonight starting 00:00 UTC. Sarah will be reachable until 01:00 UTC for context handover. After that, I'm the primary and Morgan is backup.

sarah (primary-oncall): Next steps (actionable): - diego: monitor alerts and escalate to infra onfirst sign of eviction spike (pager threshold: eviction_rate > 5/min). - morgan: merge the autoscaler threshold fix PR after smoke test in staging. - me: file post-incident doc with timeline and cost estimate.

ops-notify-bot: Alert rule restored to normal thresholds (after rollback).

morgan (eng-sre): ETA for full eu-west recovery: ~45-90 minutes depending on backlog drain. I'll post updates to this thread.

sarah (primary-oncall): Anything else before I sign off? :wave:

diego (secondary): All clear from me. Thanks for the quick revert. I'll pick up monitoring and update infra if we see repeat churn. :thumbsup:

morgan (eng-sre): Will post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems and link it here when ready.

sarah (primary-oncall): Great. Handoff complete — leaving notes in runbook and ticket. Good job team. :clap:
